usageNotes: Returns the list of available sub-command directories (e.g. 'state', 'start', 'stop', 'restart', 'reload') for a specific system service on a given node. Use this as a discovery step before calling service action endpoints — the returned 'subdir' values tell you which operations are valid for that service. Requires Sys.Audit on the node; the node must be online and reachable by the PVE API.

examples.summary: List available sub-commands for the pveproxy service on node pve01

tips: The returned 'subdir' values directly map to child API paths: e.g. a 'state' subdir corresponds to GET /nodes/{node}/services/{service}/state.
Not all services expose the same set of subdirs — always discover before assuming a sub-command like 'reload' exists for a given service.
Service names are an enum; submitting an unlisted service name will result in a 400 error rather than a graceful empty response.
